title: Set the GPU planner Candidate default CAPEX to 100 oku JPY
instruction: Transcribed from Sato Kento's September 8, 2026 explicit request to standardize every active GPU-centric AI for Science Candidate initial-CAPEX condition at 100 oku JPY, including tests. The public on-premises, hosted, and hybrid planning requests, browser defaults and TEST ONLY example, generated public-evidence results, publication digest, documentation, and regression tests must remain consistent. This authorizes preparation of the Pull Request update and publication only after an authorized merge and successful Pages deployment; it does not authorize merging, asserting scientific Consensus, recommending a vendor, publishing non-public information, or using the Candidate for procurement.
